svg.text: Raspberry Pi 3B+ - protoboard HAT - MCP3208 - six sensor channels. Every net is named, and the net name is what you write on the wire.
I2C bus @ 100 kHz (was 400 kHz - fault F2)
pressure - the only sensor kept inside
RTC - fit a FRESH coin cell
two cables leave the box, not six
PASSIVES none of these are optional
mandatory - 1-Wire will not work without it
omit if your DHT22 breakout already has one
local decoupling, close to the chip
+5 V -> GND, at the MQ feed
Do NOT add I2C pull-ups: the Pi 3B+ already has 1k8 on GPIO2/GPIO3.
NOT in the box - it would read the box
self-heating; a labelled proxy, not calibrated
pot the top 25 mm or it dies in weeks
equalises through a 2 mm side-wall vent
Generated by scripts/gen_drawings.py - edit the net list there, not this SVG.
HICS - Himalayan Institute for Contextual Sciences - IESH v0.2 - Lalitpur rooftop
